HR systems, processes and reports that support management decisions and workforce planning, along with accurate, confidential employee records. The employee lifecycle. Onboarding, regularisation, employment changes and offboarding, including the notices that go with them. Recruitment. The review cycle, coaching support for managers, and grievances, disciplinary processes and investigations handled fairly and in line with company policy and labor law. Partnership with leaders. Work with Service Delivery Managers and team leaders to strengthen accountability for operational performance management. Culture and engagement. Strengthen organisational culture, employee engagement and wellbeing through initiatives, internal communications, community-building and effective people management practices. Customer Satisfaction – Ensure the satisfaction of your customers and build loyalty across all channels by establishing relationships and creating the best experience for them. Merchandising – Show your creativity in attracting fellow sport lovers! Grow your business with promotions, events, and partnerships that move people through sport. jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. The ideal candidate is committed to continuous learning, open to enrolling in all necessary studies, courses, training, and workshops, and willing to obtain and pass any additional licenses required in the future.
